aboutGame.title: What is Build and Conquer?
paragraphs: Build and Conquer is a Roblox strategy experience from The Slop Company. You begin on an empty plot and develop a functioning country with roads, housing, farms, shops, factories, power plants and water networks. Population supplies workers, commercial buildings generate money, and utilities keep the whole city operating.

As your nation expands, Build and Conquer adds research, vehicle and missile manufacturing, troop deployment through tunnels, alliances, city defense and battles over strategic areas. Our guides cover each system from the first utility connection through late-game military production.

modules.name: Build and Conquer Beginner Guide
modules.description: Walk through the first hour: claim your plot, lay roads, supply power and water, zone housing and build income before expanding the military.

highlights.detail: Secure power and water coverage before placing your first block of housing.
Add housing to supply residents and workers, then verify that utilities are connected.
Open commercial buildings such as shops once workers and utilities can support them.
Reinvest income into more housing, services and production instead of rushing an army.
Build farms and resource chains to cover food, coal, iron and oil needs.
Add military production and defense after the civilian economy can fund them.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Build and Conquer.

items.question: What is Build and Conquer?
items.answer: Build and Conquer is a Roblox strategy game from The Slop Company. You develop a country from an empty plot, manage housing, workers, utilities and production, then research technology and build a military to defend your territory and fight over strategic areas.

items.question: What should I build first in Build and Conquer?
items.answer: Start with power and water, add housing so residents can supply workers, and then place commercial buildings such as shops. Keep each new building connected to the utilities and workforce it needs.

items.question: How do I increase population in Build and Conquer?
items.answer: Build residential housing and supply it with water and power. Larger homes and apartments add more residents, and those residents provide the workers needed by businesses and production buildings.

items.question: How does money work in Build and Conquer?
items.answer: Commercial buildings are the main source of Build and Conquer money. They need workers from housing plus the power, water and other inputs shown in their building details, so compare income with construction and upkeep costs.

items.question: What can I research in Build and Conquer?
items.answer: Research in Build and Conquer supports advanced production, military equipment, vehicles, missiles and stronger defenses. Keep the civilian economy stable so factories and research projects have the workers and resources they need.

items.question: Does Build and Conquer have multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes. Build and Conquer matches can host up to eight players on a shared map. Players can form alliances, defend their cities, deploy troops through tunnels and compete for strategic areas.

items.question: Where can I find Build and Conquer codes?
items.answer: The official Build and Conquer experience page does not list redeemable codes or a code-entry menu. Watch official The Slop Company announcements and never enter your Roblox password on a third-party rewards site.
